description: Schedule a maintenance window for a target. During maintenance, alerts and notifications are suppressed. Supports one-time, daily, and weekly recurring windows.

endsAt.description: End time as ISO 8601 string, e.g. "2026-04-05T04:00:00Z"

name.description: Name for the window, e.g. "Weekly deploy"

recurrence.description: Recurrence pattern (required if isRecurring is true)

startsAt.description: Start time as ISO 8601 string, e.g. "2026-04-05T02:00:00Z"

name: create_maintenance_window
title: Create Maintenance Window
